metadata.question: Did Cambodia have more active fire during February than October from 2014 to 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: I need to compare active fire activity in Cambodia between February and October across 2014-2017. I'll use the MODIS Fire and Thermal Anomalies dataset (MCD64A1 or FIRMS data via ee.ImageCollection). 2. Masking strategy: Fire data doesn't require cloud masking in the traditional sense—I'm looking at fire detections themselves. I'll filter for active fires within Cambodia's boundary. 3. Logic to distinguish: - C1: If no fire data exists for either month/year combination - C2: If data exists but fire pixel counts are 0 (no fires detected) - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN - A/B: Compare total fire activity (pixel count or sum) between February and October I'll use MODIS Thermal Anomalies (MOD14A1) or the FIRMS dataset to count fire pixels for each month. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions cambodia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[102.3, 10.1], [107.6, 10.1], [107.6, 14.7], [102.3, 14.7], [102.3, 10.1]] ]) # 2. Data Acquisition for Active Fire # Using MODIS/006/MOD14A1 (daily fire and thermal anomalies) fires = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') # Collect February data (2014-2017) february_fires = fires.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month')) \ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2014, 2017, 'year')) \ .filter(ee.Filter.bounds(cambodia)) # Collect October data (2014-2017) october_fires = fires.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(10, 10, 'month')) \ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2014, 2017, 'year')) \ .filter(ee.Filter.bounds(cambodia)) feb_size = february_fires.size().getInfo() oct_size = october_fires.size().getInfo() print(f"February images: {feb_size}") print(f"October images: {oct_size}") if feb_size == 0 or oct_size == 0: print("No fire data available for one or both months.") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing - Count fire pixels (FireMask band > 0 indicates fire) # FireMask: 0=no fire, 1-8=confidence levels feb_fire_count = february_fires.select('FireMask') \ .map(lambda img: img.gt(0).rename('fire_pixel')) \ .sum() \ .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=cambodia, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) oct_fire_count = october_fires.select('FireMask') \ .map(lambda img: img.gt(0).rename('fire_pixel')) \ .sum() \ .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=cambodia, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) feb_count = feb_fire_count.get('fire_pixel').getInfo() oct_count = oct_fire_count.get('fire_pixel').getInfo() print(f"February fire pixels: {feb_count}") print(f"October fire pixels: {oct_count}") # 4. Validation & Final Answer if feb_count is None or oct_count is None: print("C3") elif feb_count == 0 and oct_count == 0: print("No active fires detected in either month.") print("C2") elif feb_count > oct_count: print(f"February fires ({feb_count}) > October fires ({oct_count})") print("A") else: print(f"February fires ({feb_count}) <= October fires ({oct_count})") print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
cambodia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[102.3, 10.1], [107.6, 10.1], [107.6, 14.7], [102.3, 14.7], [102.3, 10.1]]
])

# 2. Data Acquisition for Active Fire
# Using MODIS/006/MOD14A1 (daily fire and thermal anomalies)
fires = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1')

# Collect February data (2014-2017)
february_fires = fires.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month')) \
                       .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2014, 2017, 'year')) \
                       .filter(ee.Filter.bounds(cambodia))

# Collect October data (2014-2017)
october_fires = fires.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(10, 10, 'month')) \
                      .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2014, 2017, 'year')) \
                      .filter(ee.Filter.bounds(cambodia))

feb_size = february_fires.size().getInfo()
oct_size = october_fires.size().getInfo()

print(f"February images: {feb_size}")
print(f"October images: {oct_size}")

if feb_size == 0 or oct_size == 0:
    print("No fire data available for one or both months.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Count fire pixels (FireMask band > 0 indicates fire)
    # FireMask: 0=no fire, 1-8=confidence levels
    
    feb_fire_count = february_fires.select('FireMask') \
                        .map(lambda img: img.gt(0).rename('fire_pixel')) \
                        .sum() \
                        .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), 
                                    geometry=cambodia, 
                                    scale=1000, 
                                    maxPixels=1e9)
    
    oct_fire_count = october_fires.select('FireMask') \
                        .map(lambda img: img.gt(0).rename('fire_pixel')) \
                        .sum() \
                        .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), 
                                    geometry=cambodia, 
                                    scale=1000, 
                                    maxPixels=1e9)
    
    feb_count = feb_fire_count.get('fire_pixel').getInfo()
    oct_count = oct_fire_count.get('fire_pixel').getInfo()
    
    print(f"February fire pixels: {feb_count}")
    print(f"October fire pixels: {oct_count}")
    
    # 4. Validation & Final Answer
    if feb_count is None or oct_count is None:
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif feb_count == 0 and oct_count == 0:
        print("No active fires detected in either month.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif feb_count > oct_count:
        print(f"February fires ({feb_count}) > October fires ({oct_count})")
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print(f"February fires ({feb_count}) <= October fires ({oct_count})")
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
